bio.text: Kyle Austin, the owner of Pharm406, an independent pharmacy based in Billings, is the Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate in Montana in 2026.
He also owns family farmland west of Havre and previously ran twice for Montana's eastern U.S. House seat as a Republican, in 2022 and 2024.
In a Montana Public Radio interview, Austin said he is a fourth-generation Montanan raised on the Hi-Line and a graduate of the University of Montana's School of Pharmacy.
